title: Wohnen
description: Name the rooms and furniture of a flat and say where things are, read a simple housing advert for rent, size, rooms and date, ask a landlord about a flat, say in very simple words that something is broken, read a notice in the stairwell and a message from a neighbour, and leave a short note. Grammar: in, an, auf, neben, vor, hinter and zwischen as fixed chunks with the dative form given, and nicht and kein again.
